growth_thesis.basis: Stated in P7 and F2. The condition is inferred from the segment cost discussion in P4.
growth_thesis.claim: Earnings are growing faster than sales: operating income rose 22.4% to $83.8 million against sales growth of 16.7%, and adjusted EBITDA margin was 22.8% versus 21.3% a year earlier (non-GAAP). This requires volume and price gains to keep outrunning cost growth.
quotes: Operating income of $83.8 million, up 22.4%

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in F2, P4 and P7.
growth_thesis.claim: Lower interest cost supports earnings: net interest expense fell to 10,807 (table in thousands) from 13,665. The weighted average rate fell from 6.20% to 5.22%, and net leverage was 1.3x. This continues only if debt keeps falling and rates stay lower.
quotes: a 98 basis point decrease in the weighted average interest rate, from 6.20% in the prior year quarter to 5.22% in the current quarter

growth_thesis.basis: Guidance and first-half paydown are stated in P7. That the gap depends on second-half cash is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: The raised guidance depends on debt reduction that has barely started: guidance assumes debt reduction of $100 to $140 million and interest expense of $35 to $45 million, while the company reports paying down $15.0 million in the first half. The cash generation needed to reach the guided paydown is not shown.
quotes: Debt reduction in the range of $100 to $140 million.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in P7, F2 and P6.
growth_thesis.claim: Per-share growth is also supported by buybacks and dividend increases: the company repurchased 136,303 shares for $20.0 million at an average $146.71, and diluted shares were 30,123,000 versus 30,244,000. The quarterly dividend was $0.24 versus $0.20. This continues only if cash flow funds both alongside debt reduction and capital expenditures.
quotes: Repurchased 136,303 shares of common stock, or $20.0 million at an average purchase price of $146.71
Currently, share repurchases may not exceed 6% of our market capitalization per fiscal year.

growth_thesis.claim: Management raised fiscal-year guidance to sales of $1.825 - $1.875 billion and adjusted diluted EPS of $7.00 - $7.30. This holds only if its stated assumptions are met, including the new Washington, Missouri plant being accretive and the guided capital spending.
quotes: The newly built Washington, Missouri plant is expected to be accretive to earnings in FY2027.

growth_thesis.basis: Figures are stated in F3 and F1. The link between sales growth and receivables is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Funding growth requires working-capital discipline: first-half operating cash was 139,991 (table in thousands), and changes in current assets and liabilities used 31,255 as trade receivables rose to 179,065 from 142,648. Growth in sales therefore ties up cash unless working capital is managed.
quotes: will continue to focus on disciplined management of working capital, capital expenditures, and debt

material_events.basis: stated in the cited earnings release

quotes: We are raising our fiscal year guidance for the year ending February 28, 2027, which reflects our confidence in the Company's strategic execution, operational resilience, and market positioning.

quotes: On October 8, 2026, AZZ Inc. issued a press release announcing that its Board of Directors has declared and authorized a fiscal year 2027 second quarter cash dividend of $0.24 per share on the Company's outstanding shares of common stock.

During the first quarter of fiscal 2026, AVAIL completed the sale of the Electrical Products Group

risks.basis: Figures are stated in F1 and F2. The mechanism is inferred from the prior-year sale gains described in P4 and P7.
risks.claim: Reported GAAP earnings leaned heavily on AVAIL JV gains in the prior year and the JV contribution has shrunk. Six-month net income was 110,457 against 260,254 a year earlier (table in thousands). Equity in earnings fell to 7,298 from 232,868 (table in thousands). The AVAIL investment on the balance sheet fell to 11,464 from 19,960 (table in thousands).
quotes: Excludes the potential for equity in income (or loss) and cash distributions from AZZ's minority interest in its unconsolidated subsidiary.

risks.basis: Cash, debt and cash flow are stated in F1 and F3. Leverage and covenant compliance are stated in P7 and P3. The liquidity risk itself is inferred.
risks.claim: The balance sheet holds very little cash against sizeable, largely variable-rate debt. Cash was 1,953 and long-term debt, net was 468,470 (table in thousands). Funding therefore relies on continued access to the revolver and the receivables facility.
quotes: an increase in our debt leverage and/or interest rates on our debt, of which a significant portion is tied to variable interest rates

risks.basis: The cost increase is stated in P4. The margin-squeeze mechanism is inferred and the risk factor in P2 supports it.
risks.claim: Input costs are rising. Zinc cost was the largest named driver of a $30.5 million increase in Metal Coatings cost of sales in the quarter. If these costs are not passed through, segment margins could narrow.
quotes: The $30.5 million increase in cost of sales was primarily due to an $11.3 million increase in zinc costs

risks.basis: The risk is stated in P2. There is no evidence of a realized impact in the packet.
risks.claim: Changes to U.S. trade policy or tariffs are a disclosed risk to demand and costs. The packet does not quantify any impact.
quotes: new tariffs or changes in existing tariffs

risks.basis: The cyclicality is stated in P2. The end-market declines are stated in P4. The sensitivity is inferred.
risks.claim: Demand is cyclical and seasonal, and some Precoat end markets already weakened in the quarter. HVAC and appliances, transportation and other end markets were lower even as total sales rose.
quotes: Our business segments are cyclical and are sensitive to economic downturns.
partially offset by decreases in HVAC and appliances, transportation, and other end markets

risks.basis: Guidance and the debt paydown are stated in P7. The pacing concern is inferred by comparison.
risks.claim: Raised fiscal 2027 guidance leaves the second half to deliver. Debt paid down in the first half was $15.0 million, against full-year debt reduction guidance of $100 to $140 million. The guidance also excludes further M&A and federal regulatory changes.
quotes: Debt reduction in the range of $100 to $140 million.

risks.basis: Balances are stated in F1. The impairment risk is inferred, and the only impairment in the packet relates to the JV.
risks.claim: Goodwill and intangibles are a large share of assets, so an impairment would hit reported results. Goodwill was 740,210 and intangibles 417,978 against total assets of 2,337,958 (table in thousands). The company already took an impairment loss on the AVAIL JV in fiscal 2026.
quotes: an impairment loss recognized on the AVAIL JV in the second quarter of fiscal 2026

risks.basis: Both events are stated in P3 and P6. The wider control concern is inferred.
risks.claim: The JV recorded a prior-period adjustment for accounting errors in its Brazil operations. AZZ also had to file a 10-Q/A because a required repurchase disclosure was omitted. These are reporting-quality flags but not a restatement of AZZ's financials.
quotes: a prior period adjustment for accounting errors within the Brazil operations of the AVAIL JV
which was inadvertently omitted from the Original Form 10-Q

risks.basis: Ages and dates are stated in P1. The disruption risk is stated generally in P2 and is inferred for these individuals.
risks.claim: Leadership transition risk exists. The CEO is 69 and has held the role since 2013, and the Metal Coatings operating chief retired in June 2026. The 10-K lists loss of key personnel as a risk.
quotes: The departure of key personnel could disrupt our business.
Effective March 1, 2026, Todd Bella was appointed President — Metal Coatings to succeed Bryan Stovall.
